say:0:1423117001:0.text: Hyla and Ironbeard are here. Have they decided on anything?
say:0:1423117001:0.source_cn: 海拉和铁须都在这里，已经讨论出什么结果了吗？
say:0:1423117001:0.male: Hyla and Ironbeard are here. Have they decided on anything?
say:0:1423117001:0.female: Hyla and Ironbeard are here. Have they decided on anything?

say:4:1423119002:0.text: Ironbeard is as rigid as an old dwarf! He can't seem to accept new ideas.
say:4:1423119002:0.source_cn: 这个铁须，年纪轻轻的，思想可真是个老顽固，一点新事物都...

say:5:1423119003:1.text: I showed him some ancient research documents about arcane steel, along with a prototype we made last time. He's still not convinced!
say:5:1423119003:1.source_cn: 我刚才给他看了帝国时期研究魔钢的文件，还有上次注入魔力...

say:6:1423119004:1.text: You could have made these up. I can't just take your word for it.
say:6:1423119004:1.source_cn: 这些东西都有造假的可能。我不可能凭这些就相信你们。

say:7:1423119005:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style> and Hyla, could you both take Ironbeard to the mine and show him how we enchant the celestrites?
say:7:1423119005:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style> and Hyla, could you both take Ironbeard to the mine and show him how we enchant the celestrites?
say:7:1423119005:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style> and Hyla, could you both take Ironbeard to the mine and show him how we enchant the celestrites?

say:8:1423119006:1.text: This should solve your concern, Ironbeard.
say:8:1423119006:1.source_cn: 这样就绝对没有造假的可能了吧。

say:4:1423120002:1.text: Got any work for us? We can do it fast and well for you!
say:4:1423120002:1.source_cn: 有什么活要俺们干的吗？俺们手脚麻利得很！

say:5:1423120003:1.text: Look at you, so motivated to work now!
say:5:1423120003:1.source_cn: 你现在干活倒是积极起来了。

say:6:1423120004:1.text: Well, we've officially joined Ironbeard's side.
say:6:1423120004:1.source_cn: 毕竟俺们正式加入铁须老大这边了嘛。

say:7:1423120005:1.text: No need to do anything now.
say:7:1423120005:1.source_cn: 现在还用不着你们动手干活。

say:8:1423120006:1.text: If what I see later is good enough, I believe everyone will be eager to put in the work.
say:8:1423120006:1.source_cn: 要是等会看到的东西能让我满意，我相信大伙干多少活都愿意。

say:9:1423120007:1.text: Fair enough... We'll gather the celestrites ourselves.
say:9:1423120007:1.source_cn: 行吧……既然没有人干活，我们就亲自去采些天青矿吧。

say:2:1423121001:0.text: Ironbeard, take a look. You can see that we haven't tampered with the celestrites in any way.
say:2:1423121001:0.source_cn: 铁须，你拿在手上检查一下，这些刚采回来的天青矿我们动没...

say:3:1423121002:0.text: True, nothing seems off with these celestrites...
say:3:1423121002:0.source_cn: 确实是最为普通的天青矿，没有被动过手脚的迹象……

say:4:1423121003:1.text: Now, it's time for <style="stress"><player_name></style> to enchant the celestrites.
say:4:1423121003:1.male: Now, it's time for <style="stress"><player_name></style> to enchant the celestrites.
say:4:1423121003:1.female: Now, it's time for <style="stress"><player_name></style> to enchant the celestrites.

say:0:1423122001:1.text: As the magic takes effect, the translucent blue ore grows deeper in color, eventually giving off a metallic glint.
say:0:1423122001:1.source_cn: 魔力注入后，半透明蓝色矿石的颜色变得更加饱满，渐渐闪耀...

say:3:1423122002:0.text: T-This is truly amazing... Not only does the ore look different, but it also seems to take on new properties!
say:3:1423122002:0.source_cn: 这、这确实神奇……不光是矿石的外形，连性质似乎都发生了改变。

say:4:1423122003:0.text: Hold on... It might be just a magic trick. I need to run a test on it before coming to a conclusion.
say:4:1423122003:0.source_cn: 等等……说不定是魔法师的戏法。我得检验矿石的性质和优劣...
say:4:1423122003:0.male: Hold on... It might be just a magic trick. I need to run a test on it before coming to a conclusion.
say:4:1423122003:0.female: Hold on... It might be just a magic trick. I need to run a test on it before coming to a conclusion.

say:5:1423122004:1.text: Aren't you a cautious one... You can take it to the smelting workshop and forge something with it.
say:5:1423122004:1.source_cn: 你还真是严谨……那就去冶炼所锻造看看吧。

say:0:1423123001:0.text: How about making a simple greatsword?
say:0:1423123001:0.source_cn: 先锻把基础的矮人钢巨剑吧。

document:0:235:0.text:
Main Material:
<style="highlight">Enchanted Celestrite</style>: Hammer it into a thin sheet and place it in the leftmost groove of the anvil.
Other Materials:
<style="highlight">Moonlit Silver</style>: Place in the second section, following the markings on the mold.
<style="highlight">Blackstone Dust</style>: Place in the third section, following the markings on the mold.

Strike the enchanted celestrite repeatedly with a heavy hammer to ensure it combines well with the other materials. During hot forging, monitor the temperature and reheat if needed.
document:0:235:0.source_cn:
"主材：
<style="highlight">注魔后的天青矿</style>，锤打至片状，置于铁砧中央凹槽
配料：
<style="highlight">月光银</style>，按模具标注在辅料A栏位注入至满
<style="highlight">黑石粉</style>，按模具标注在辅料B栏位倒入至满
锻造时需用重锤反复击打注魔后的天青矿，使其与辅料充分结合。热锻过程中需时刻注意温度，必要时重新加热。"

say:0:1423124001:0.source_cn: 让铁须看看锻造的成品吧。

say:1:1423125001:1.source_cn: 看看注魔后的天青矿锻造出的成品，还满意吗？

say:2:1423125002:1.text: Hmm, let me see. A-Are you sure this isn't made from echorites?!
say:2:1423125002:1.source_cn: 嗯……我看看。这、这确定不是用深岩晶锻造的吗？

say:3:1423125003:1.text: Teota and Hawke, look at this!
say:3:1423125003:1.source_cn: 铁哥达，哈卡，你们也来看看。

say:5:1423125004:1.text: Wow, this sword is terrific! The blade is sharp and sturdy!
say:5:1423125004:1.source_cn: 好一把削铁如泥的宝剑！既锋利，又韧性十足！

say:7:1423125005:1.text: How can it be so light but so tough at the same time? Unbelievable...
say:7:1423125005:1.source_cn: 而且重量是怎么做到如此之轻的？能保持硬度和韧性的同时，...

say:8:1423125006:1.text: Not even swords forged from regular echorites come close...
say:8:1423125006:1.source_cn: 普通深岩晶锻造的剑都达不到这样的程度……

say:9:1423125007:1.text: Ironbeard, this arcane steel is no joke!
say:9:1423125007:1.source_cn: 大哥，这魔钢有点东西啊！

say:11:1423125008:1.text: If it can be mass-produced, it'll be the ideal substitute for echorite...
say:11:1423125008:1.source_cn: 要是能大批量投产的话，确实能替代深岩晶……

say:12:1423125009:1.text: But that's not possible with just the Magister doing the infusion.
say:12:1423125009:1.male: But that's not possible with just the Magister doing the infusion.
say:12:1423125009:1.female: But that's not possible with just the Magister doing the infusion.

say:13:1423125010:1.text: Once the production line is up and running, we'll need thousands of the arcane steel, not just one or two!
say:13:1423125010:1.source_cn: 等生产线运转起来，要的可不是一两块魔钢，而是成千上万块！

say:14:1423125011:0.text: That's where the collaboration with Sal'thorin comes in. Many of the Essail there are mages, so they can help us with the magic!
say:14:1423125011:0.source_cn: 所以祖娅和我想推进和萨洛克兰的合作，那里有大批会魔法的...

say:15:1423125012:1.text: Hmph, I suppose they won't be helping us for free, huh?
say:15:1423125012:1.source_cn: 哼，要是无利可图的话，他们怎么会愿意做这些？

choice_prompt:16:1423125012.text: Hmph, I suppose they won't be helping us for free, huh?
choice_prompt:16:1423125012.source_cn: 哼，要是无利可图的话，他们怎么会愿意做这些？

say:17:1423125013:1.text: If you're still skeptical, join us in meeting the Essail.
say:17:1423125013:1.source_cn: 如果你满肚子的疑虑无法打消的话，就跟我们一起去确认合作...

say:18:1423125014:1.text: Guess it won't hurt to meet them...

say:19:1423125015:1.text: It's a deal then! We'll have Zanie organize the meeting.
say:19:1423125015:1.source_cn: 那就这么说定了，我们去请祖娅安排会面吧！

choice:16:0:1.source_cn: 去亲眼看看艾塞勒的现状如何？

choice:16:1:2.source_cn: 去听听艾塞勒提出的条件如何？

say:0:1423126001:0.text: Phew... Ironbeard seems close to changing his mind. Let's fill Zanie in on our progress!
say:0:1423126001:0.source_cn: 呼……铁须终于松口了，跟祖娅汇报一下进展吧！

say:2:1423127001:1.text: Zanie! Ironbeard has agreed to come with us to Sal'thorin to meet the Essail!
say:2:1423127001:1.source_cn: 祖娅！铁须同意跟我们一起去萨洛克兰了解合作的具体情形了！

say:4:1423127003:1.text: Got it, I'll get in touch with Indris as soon as possible to arrange a meeting.
say:4:1423127003:1.source_cn: 我知道了，我会尽快联系因度厄，准备商议合作的事宜。

say:5:1423127004:1.text: Let me check with Indris about our visit. I'll update you once I have something concrete.
say:5:1423127004:1.source_cn: 接下来要麻烦你们等等我这边交涉的进展了。

say:6:1423127005:1.text: Let's hope the collaboration goes smoothly...
say:6:1423127005:1.source_cn: 希望合作的推进能顺利吧……
